scripts.dev: set PORT=9527 && next dev --experimental-https --experimental-https-key certificates/localhost-key.pem --experimental-https-cert certificates/localhost.pem
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const rm=(p)=>fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});const mkdir=(p)=>fs.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true});const cp=(src,dst)=>fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true,force:true});const pubBase=path.join('.next','standalone','public');for(const d of ['cut','generated','generated-edits','material','reference-images']) rm(path.join(pubBase,d));const srcStatic=path.join('.next','static');const dstStatic=path.join('.next','standalone','.next','static');rm(dstStatic);mkdir(dstStatic);cp(srcStatic,dstStatic);"
